english.title: Passenger in a driver only PCV fail to pay on boarding / in accordance with directions the fare for the journey
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a passenger on a driver only passenger carrying vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), used for the carriage of passengers at separate fares, at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), failed to make payment of the appropriate fare

(A)_[on boarding the vehicle]_
(B)_[in accordance with directions]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 7(2)(b) of the Public Service Vehicles (Conduct of Drivers, Inspectors, Conductors and Passengers) Regulations 1990 and section 25(3) of the Public Passenger Vehicles Act 1981.
